content.text: {"summary":"With q=u=0, the velocity response is almost exactly linear. Its slope is about -0.769 across [-1,1]. The units that carry velocity there are 2, 3, 7, 9, 10, 11, 12 and 13. Unit 3 switches off and unit 11 switches on near v≈-0.13, and their slopes nearly cancel, so the gradient stays at about -0.769 on both sides. Because the v|v| term contributes no slope at v=0, I read the linear damping as c ≈ 0.769. A residual quadratic-drag contribution may be folded into this figure, so treat it as an estimate. To add -c*v, I used the two unused hidden units 1 and 6 as ReLU(v) and ReLU(-v), with output weights -c and +c. This adds exactly -c*v everywhere and leaves all other behavior unchanged.","estimated_c":0.7693,"patches":[{"tensor":"W1","index":[1,1],"value":1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[1],"value":-0.7693},{"tensor":"W1","index":[6,1],"value":-1.0},{"tensor":"W2","index":[6],"value":0.7693}]}
